{{Short description|Chinese-American molecular biologist (1931–2020)}}
'''Pien-Chien Huang''' ({{zh|t=黃秉乾|p=Huáng Bǐngqián}}; 13 July 1931 – 3 August 2020) was a Chinese-American molecular biologist.

== Life and career ==
Huang was born in [[Shanghai]] on 13 July 1931. He graduated from [[National Taiwan University]] in 1952 with a bachelor's degree in agriculture.<ref name="asprofifle">{{cite news |title=P. C. Huang |url=https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=88 |accessdate=4 February 2019 |publisher=Academia Sinica}}</ref> Huang then earned a master's degree at [[Virginia Tech]] in 1956, followed by a doctorate from [[Ohio State University]] in 1960.<ref>{{cite news |title=Pien-Chien Huang, PhD |url=https://www.jhsph.edu/faculty/directory/profile/323/pien-chien-huang |accessdate=4 February 2019 |publisher=Bloomberg School of Public Health}}</ref> He was elected to the [[Academia Sinica]] in 1986, and taught at [[National Tsing Hua University]] in Taiwan from 1993 to 1996, concurrently serving as dean of the College of Life Sciences at NTHU.<ref name="asprofifle"/><ref>{{cite news |title=Academicians |url=http://archives.lib.nthu.edu.tw/history/en/academicians.html |accessdate=4 February 2019 |publisher=National Tsing-hua University}}</ref> Huang taught at [[Johns Hopkins University]]'s [[Bloomberg School of Public Health]] for five decades,<ref name="asprofifle"/><ref>{{cite news |title=BMB Centennial Celebration |url=https://www.jhsph.edu/departments/biochemistry-and-molecular-biology/centennial/index.html |accessdate=4 February 2019 |publisher=Bloomberg School of Public Health}}</ref> where he was professor of biochemistry and molecular biology.<ref>{{cite news |title=Pien-Chien Huang |url=https://biophysics.jhu.edu/directory/pien-chien-huang/ |accessdate=4 February 2019 |publisher=Johns Hopkins University}}</ref> Huang was also a correspondence research fellow at Academia Sinica.<ref>{{cite news |title=Adjunct Faculty |url=http://www.imb.sinica.edu.tw/en/research/adjunct_faculty.html |accessdate=4 February 2019 |publisher=Institute of Molecular Biology, Academia Sinica}}</ref> He was married to [[Ru-Chih Chow Huang]] from 1956 to his death in 2020.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Pelton |first1=Tom |title=Scientist, stung by criticism, is defiant |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/2001/12/16/scientist-stung-by-criticism-is-defiant/ |access-date=4 February 2019 |work=Baltimore Sun |date=16 December 2001}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=In Memoriam: Pien-Chien (P.C.) Huang (1931-2020) |url=https://publichealth.jhu.edu/2020/in-memoriam-pien-chien-pc-huang-1931-2020 |access-date=2 February 2022 |publisher=Johns Hopkins University |date=6 August 2020}}</ref>
